page.layout: One printed page, single text column with a title block above it; verse numbers hang in the left margin beside lines 1 to 4; a catchword-like signature "B.i." sits at the foot right. Page number "I" at top right.

main_text.head: Ioannis Caluini IN LIBRVM IOSVE
main_text.p: breuis Commentarius, quem paulò ante mortem absoluit.
main_text.head: CAPVT I.
main_text.p: 1VIT autem post mortem Mosis, vt Iehoua alloqueretur Iosue dicédo, 2Moses seruus meus mortuus est: nunc ergo surge, traiice Iordané istum tu, & omnis hic populus, ad terrā quam ego do illis, nempe filiis Israel.
3Omnem locum quem calcauerit planta pedis vestri vobis dedi: quemadmodum loquutus sum Mosi,
4A deserto & Libano isto vsque ad flumen magnum, flumen Euphraten, tota terra Hitthæorum vsque ad mare magnum ad occasum solis, erit terminus vester.

page.notes: Initial E is a large decorated woodcut letter, read as E. Verse numbers 1 to 4 are set in the left margin. The "V" of "VIT" is the joined initial. Some ink specks on the scan were ignored.
